messages:
alex: Kicking off blue->green traffic shift for eu-west2. Plan: raise green from 5% -> 50% over ~20m (10 steps). Change window now. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-eu-infer @sre-oncall @jen

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] traffic-shift job created id=ts-1768509999. Automated steps every 2m, health checks enabled (p95, 5xx, error-rate). Progress updates posted here.

jen: Confirming router cookie set to `session_v2` (sticky to green). Affinity timeout = 15m. I pushed `router-eu-west.cfg` change (line 118).

sre-oncall: Watching metrics. Abort/rollback criteria: p95 > 700ms OR 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m. Will escalate immediately if seen.

alex: Canary on green looks clean so far. Saw a few 429s from a single client IP range; not model errors. No 5xx in last 10m.

deploy-bot: progress update: 5% -> 10% (step 1 -> step 2). Healthy checks passing.

sam: Starting synthetic traffic probe (small ramp). Running quick load test to validate tail latencies.
```bash
hey -n 2000 -c 50 -m POST 'https://api-eu-west.inference.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'
```

olivia: FYI: warmed KV/prefix cache on green a few minutes ago; expect short p95 blips while caches settle. Quantized-variant fallback enabled for green in case of memory pressure.

jen: CDN invalidation scheduled in ~8m for /model-cache/* — I'll run it after we hit 30% to avoid double-cache-thrashing.

deploy-bot: progress update: 10% -> 30% (step 3 -> step 5). Health checks still green.

sre-oncall: Quick metric snapshot: p95=220ms, error-rate=0.02%, 5xx=0.01% — within thresholds. No abort.

alex: Rolling rollback command saved in chat ops notes in case:
```bash
# emergency rollback to blue
routerctl set-weight router-eu-west green 0 && routerctl set-weight router-eu-west blue 100
```
I'll execute if we trip abort criteria.

deploy-bot: progress update: 30% -> 50% — target reached. Post-shift validations kicking off.

jen: Post-shift checklist: tag release rel/2026-03-eu, update release notes with runtime metrics, annotate `router-eu-west.cfg` with cookie fallback comment.

sam: Quick check in Sentry and internal error-tracker: no new user-facing issues for green.

sre-oncall: Marking watch window as stable for now. Will keep an eye for 1h. Ping me for any anomalies.

alex: Nice work. Leaving post-deploy monitoring for the hour — will close when stable. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: traffic-shift job ts-1768509999 finished successfully. status=done, job_id=ts-1768509999

olivia: Adding final note: prefix/KV cache warmed, quantized fallback verified, cookie affinity left enabled (15m) to avoid seam traffic.

jen: DONE :shipit: 

alex: Closing thread — thanks team! :party:
